title: Sanitation District Billing Dispute
categories: Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection
description: Use this service request only for sanitation billing disputes related to cost-plus or brush/bulk debris removal, business/commercial or pack-out garbage/recycle service, questions on frequency of service received, residential roll-cart(s) quantity, and property inspections. A person claiming entitlement to a refund/credit must provide notification to the Sanitation Department within 180 days (6 months) from the date the disputed payment was received by the City or day of collection service. The estimated response time for a service request of this nature is 5 business days.

A person claiming entitlement to a refund/credit must provide notification to the Sanitation Department within 180 days (6 months) from the date the disputed payment was received by the City or day of collection service.

Oversize and other non-compliant brush/bulk set-outs are collected and automatically billed to customers at a rate of $60.00 per 5 cubic yards, billed in 5 cubic yard increments (Dallas City Code Section 18-4(h)).

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to dispute a Sanitation charge or collection service.
actions.why: For a Sanitation billing dispute involving cost-plus or brush/bulk debris removal, commercial or pack-out garbage and recycling, service frequency, residential roll-cart quantity, or property inspection. The 311 request form asks for the Dallas Water Utilities account, service and dispute type, and any prior service request number. A person seeking a refund or credit must notify Sanitation within 180 days of the disputed payment or collection service.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Sanitation District Billing Dispute" requests cannot continue when the requester is neither the account holder nor authorized to make account changes. A refund or credit claim falls outside the stated notification window when Sanitation is notified more than 180 days after the disputed payment or collection date.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Garbage, Recycle, and Brush/Bulky Item Collection" > Choose "Sanitation District Billing Dispute"
